name: Kropyvnytskyi

queries.query: Kropyvnytskyi official cadastral map parcel public API Ukraine
queries.result: Search identified the official National Geospatial Portal API documentation for a public, rate-limited parcel lookup by coordinates or cadastral number, plus a city-specific open-data portal and a municipal urban-cadastre announcement. No directly usable citywide parcel geometry endpoint was proven.

queries.query: Кропивницький офіційна кадастрова карта земельний кадастр ділянки API
queries.result: Search identified the official municipal open-data dataset parcels_kropyvnytskyi and official National Geospatial Portal documentation. The municipal dataset description exposes parcelId as a source field but also contains sensitive lease/party fields, so no raw records were retained. No safe public polygon response was obtained.

registryFindingBasis: Official Kropyvnytskyi municipal open-data portal documents a city-specific parcels_kropyvnytskyi dataset; official city news documents a municipal urban-cadastre geoportal and a municipal land-parcel register.
